lines: You watch the empty couch side every night.
He scrolls memes while you sit alone.
You ask if he still loves you, he sighs.
Your mind reads that silence as rejection.
That makes the loneliness cut deeper than fights.
You expect love to be constant, not occasional.
When quiet lasts, it becomes a broken boundary.
You need someone who actually fills the room.
Stop accepting a couch buddy; demand real conversation, you deserve it.
